title: Apple Slashes Daily AI Spending Caps for Its Engineers
dek: Some limits fell from $300 to $200 a day, with deeper cuts reportedly planned.

facts.label: Apple R&D spend, up 32% this year

caption:
Even Apple is starting to count its AI tokens. 💸

According to a Bloomberg report, Apple quietly cut the daily AI budget for some engineering teams from $300 to $200 per person in October. More cuts are reportedly on the table: engineers could drop to $100 a day, and some non-engineering groups may go as low as $25. Apple employees reportedly use tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, and teams are being nudged toward cheaper or on-device models.

This isn't Apple backing away from AI. Its R&D spending just jumped 32% to $45.8 billion. It's about controlling how the money is used after a year of "tokenmaxxing" across the tech industry. Apple hasn't confirmed the changes publicly.

We're tracking how companies rethink AI budgets every day at AI Parabellum. Would your team survive on $25 a day of AI?
